destination: Deliver an implementation-ready specification for BaiZe automatic requirement-design orchestration without changing business code in the Wayfinder effort.

integrationStrategy.rule: Slices S1-S6 may be committed and reviewed but are only assembled through test entrypoints. S7 is the first and only deployable version of the new runtime.

slices.name: Deterministic contract harness
slices.goal: Create one executable contract and deterministic test seam before implementing workflow behavior.
requiredBehavior: Compile and validate every Wayfinder JSON asset used at runtime.
Define ModelDriver and production PiModelDriver boundaries.
Provide ScriptedModelDriver only through test entrypoints; production main cannot select it through environment or HTTP.
Script fixtures declare expected role, context digest, ordered tool calls, structured result, and optional crash point.
Provide deterministic clock, IDs, digests, repository snapshots, operator identity, and model usage records.
ModelConfig v1 governs deployment provider/model profiles (providers + defaultRoles); create-requirement modelRoles are validated at creation; token run events carry provider+modelId.
mandatoryTests: Every contract asset has a valid schemaVersion and cross-reference.
ScriptedModelDriver fails on unexpected role, order, tool name, argument, digest, or extra call.
The production entrypoint cannot construct ScriptedModelDriver.
Fixture output is byte-stable for the same seed and inputs.
slices.completionGate: Contract validation and deterministic harness tests pass without API keys or network.
slices.revert: Revert S1 and all dependent slices before S7; no production data exists.

slices.name: Workflow governance kernel
slices.goal: Persist and recover Requirement-level workflow governance through the command/event transaction boundary.
requiredBehavior: Create Requirement and pending Workflow with fixed PolicyBundle in one transaction.
Implement numbered forward-only target-schema migrations without deleting legacy tables.
Implement state row plus contiguous Workflow event sequence.
Persist success, rejection, conflict, and commandId reuse receipts.
Commit command receipt, state, events, incidents, and outbox jobs atomically.
Complete startup reconciliation before any HTTP listener can accept traffic.
mandatoryTests: Every allowed and forbidden state transition from the state contract.
Command idempotency for same and different payload digests.
Workflow version and event sequence advance independently and correctly.
Transaction rollback leaves no partial receipt, state, event, or outbox row.
Startup recovery is idempotent across repeated restarts.
slices.completionGate: A headless test can create, start, pause, resume, fail, and recover a Workflow with exact receipts and event history.
slices.revert: Revert S2-S6 together before S7; reset only disposable test databases.

slices.name: Planning and task execution
slices.goal: Execute Planning and role Tasks through isolated Attempts, Runs, claims, and staged effects.
requiredBehavior: Create Planning Task to obtain a complete finite PlanProposal DAG.
Apply all static plan validators including task limits, DAG depth, role/kind mapping, symbolic input binding, and plan write-set conflicts.
Pin RoleContract, Skill, ContextManifest, RepositorySnapshot, and input version vector per Attempt.
Allow exactly one active governance Attempt claim per Workflow.
Give every Attempt an isolated Run session and preserve one Attempt to one governance Run.
Stage all mutating tool effects and publish them only after output, policy, CAS, and EffectPublicationToken checks.
Discard or audit late results without publishing or consuming failure budget when superseded.
mandatoryTests: Positive and one-negative-case-per-rule PlanProposal validation.
Stable topological scheduling and current-Task retry priority.
Claim acquisition, release, restore, and competing terminal CAS.
Output schema, tool policy, completion predicate, and staged-effect rollback failures.
pause, steer, cancel-run, replace-plan, and input mutation races.
Process loss and transcript loss recovery consume the correct budget.
slices.completionGate: ScriptedModelDriver can plan and complete ordered Tasks with auditable isolated Runs and no published partial effect.
slices.revert: Revert S3-S6 together before S7; no production route references these modules.

slices.name: Artifact quality and review loop
slices.goal: Reach a deterministic ApprovalPacket through governed artifacts, evidence, decisions, findings, Critic review, and bounded rework.
requiredBehavior: Derive Required Artifact Set from validated ImpactProfile.
Validate each Artifact kind with its versioned content schema and exact sourceRefs.
Require provenance and TraceLink evidence according to Artifact Policy.
Enforce Decision and Finding severity rules without force-ready or waivers.
Require initial blind Critic review and targeted verification after rework.
Limit each Finding Thread to two automatic rework/verify cycles.
Evaluate all eleven Readiness checks and generate content-addressed ApprovalPacket only when all pass.
mandatoryTests: Each Artifact schema accepts a minimal valid fixture and rejects missing, extra, and mistyped fields.
Every ImpactProfile dimension toggles the exact Required Artifact kind; unknown blocks.
Each of eleven Readiness checks is independently forced false while the other ten pass.
Critical, major, minor, and info Finding paths including verification and risk acceptance.
Critic zero-Finding coverage and invalid/missing verification results.
Two-cycle rework limit, unchanged fingerprint, changed target revision, and stale risk Approval.
ApprovalPacket digest changes for every governed input change.
slices.completionGate: A deterministic headless workflow reaches ready_to_archive only after complete artifacts, evidence, Critic coverage, and resolved gates.
slices.revert: Revert S4-S6 together before S7; target tables remain test-only.

slices.name: Human control and public API
slices.goal: Expose the complete automatic workflow through the unified command, projection, SSE, approval, and diagnostic contracts in a test-only server assembly.
requiredBehavior: Bootstrap Bearer credential into HttpOnly SameSite=Strict Operator Session cookie.
Implement one PUT command resource for all workflow operations.
Derive ActorRef and capabilities only from the trusted server-side session.
Return persisted Command Receipt before projection convergence.
Expose current bounded Workflow projection plus paged history and separate Workflow/Run SSE streams.
Implement deterministic Gate Queue, stale-subject rejection, immutable DecisionDisposition and Approval records, and atomic packet approval/archive.
Allow one read-only Diagnostic Run without governance effects.
Keep all new routes unregistered from the production gateway main until S7.
mandatoryTests: All command types crossed with allowed states, capabilities, expected versions, and stale subjects.
Same commandId replay, digest conflict, and concurrent command winner/loser behavior.
SSE Last-Event-ID replay, reconnect, workflow/run separation, and retention boundary.
Receipt accepted while projection remains old, followed by deterministic SSE convergence.
Approval/rejection/revocation subject digest and supersession behavior.
Diagnostic Run tool policy, one-per-Requirement claim, and governance isolation.
slices.completionGate: A test-only HTTP server completes create-to-archive and recovery flows entirely through workflow-api/v1.
slices.revert: Revert S5-S6 together before S7; production gateway registration is unchanged.

slices.name: Web operator experience
slices.goal: Implement the accepted guided workflow UI against the new projection and command contracts without exposing it in the production shell.
requiredBehavior: Default to guided summary with exactly one primary action per Workflow state.
Expand workflow detail in the same page and open audit as a separate view.
Hide pause, cancel, steer, replace-plan, and diagnostic controls by risk level.
Process one deterministic Gate Queue item at a time.
Preserve draft and freeze submission when Workflow or subject becomes stale; never auto-rebase.
Show persisted receipt separately from eventual projection confirmation.
Use a focused same-page ApprovalPacket review mode.
mandatoryTests: Vitest projection and command client tests for every state and primary action.
Playwright running, waiting, rework, failed, ready, and paused-stale scenarios.
Workflow details, gate receipt, approval, rejection, conflict, and SSE reconnect journeys.
Desktop, tablet, and mobile viewport coverage.
Keyboard navigation, focus restoration, dialog labeling, stale lock announcement, and disabled-action accessibility.
No reviewer role selector, manual Run prompt, direct archive action, or old endpoint call.
slices.completionGate: The accepted operator-experience/v1 journeys pass against the test-only S5 server at all configured viewports.
slices.revert: Revert S6 before S7; production shell still renders the legacy page.

slices.name: Cutover and hard deletion
slices.goal: Produce the only deployable automatic workflow version by migrating history, switching entrypoints, deleting the legacy path, and passing release gates.
requiredBehavior: Generate and verify CutoverReport against paired DB/Session fingerprints.
Apply the numbered migration exactly once and emit MigrationAttestation.
Classify legacy_archived, pending_reentry, and manual_asset_source records exactly as cutover-policy/v1 specifies.
Register the new API and Web entrypoints and remove all test-only assembly restrictions.
Delete legacy routes, generic Run UI, reviewer Skill/role, shared DesignSession execution, run_locks, compatibility helpers, and obsolete schema in the same version.
Replace the old network-none smoke with a complete scripted automatic Workflow smoke.
Provide workflow-doctor JSON output and enforce post-migration gates before first business write.
mandatoryTests: All S1-S6 tests on the final production assembly.
All cutover fixtures, anomaly paths, rerun idempotency, and crash points.
Negative route, symbol, file, role, UI label, SQL table/column, and Skill scans for every removed surface.
Compose network-none create-to-archive smoke through the production entrypoint.
Migration rehearsal against a paired copy of real DB and Session data.
Eight golden Requirements run three times with real model credentials.
slices.completionGate: All PR and Release Candidate gates pass, CutoverReport and MigrationAttestation reconcile, workflow-doctor reports no zero-tolerance violation, and the old path is absent.
slices.revert: Before the first post-cutover business write, restore the paired backup and old binary. After that boundary, stop new writes and forward-fix only.

PlanProposal positive and one negative per static rule
all Artifact kinds positive plus missing/extra/type negative
Role input/output schema and version pinning
removed surface manifests match cutover and API contracts
workflowStateAndCommands: seven states crossed with every command
expected workflow and subject version mismatch
concurrent valid commands first durable commit wins
rolesAndTools: four roles crossed with every domain tool
Critic initial blind and verification contexts
quality: Finding severity, rework, verification, and risk acceptance
concurrencyAndRecovery: pause and steer preserve valid in-flight result
cancel, replace-plan, and input mutation supersede
queued redispatch, running process_lost, completed finalize
transcript loss before and after effect publication
cutover: paired backup restore before first write

nightly.purpose: Additional seeds, models, long soak, and non-blocking product metric trends only.

preflight: All pull request and release candidate jobs pass.
No active legacy queued or running Run exists.
Paired DB and Session backup is complete and restorable.
cutover check report digest matches the exact apply inputs.
Old binary and restore command are available before the first business write.
cutover: Run cutover apply with exact report digest.
Run or verify the release candidate golden and rehearsal evidence.
Open business writes only after every gate passes.

rollbackBoundary.beforeFirstBusinessWrite: restore paired backup and old binary
rollbackBoundary.afterFirstBusinessWrite: stop new writes and forward-fix only

workflowDoctorChecks: outbox queue age, retries, and exhaustion
Attempt terminal state versus published effects
removed route, symbol, role, Skill, and schema surface

definitionOfDone: All seven slices satisfy their completion gates.
All pull request and release candidate gates pass.
The production main has exactly one automatic workflow path.
All cutover-policy removed surfaces are absent by negative scan.
The target database has no obsolete legacy workflow tables or columns.
The network-none compose smoke reaches archived through a real human-command simulation and ScriptedModelDriver.
The real-model golden set meets its release criteria.
CutoverReport, MigrationAttestation, paired backup evidence, and workflow-doctor report are retained.
No zero-tolerance observability violation exists at release.
Business documentation describes only the new path.
